messages.subject: ggplot2 at 0.7 in binaries?
parts:
Trying to upgrade my ggplot2, I noticed that the CRAN binaries say
that 0.7 is the latest, while the CRAN source says 0.8.3; any reason
for this discrepancy?

--J

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 at 0.7 in binaries?
